## Change and validation

Describe the failure, root cause, resulting behavior and validation commands.

- [ ] Why the change is needed: explain the problem and intended behavior.
- [ ] Docs updated: include subsystem docs, module README or compat table.
- [ ] Compat row updated: include API reference and any deviations.
- [ ] Tests added: explain regression coverage and results.
- [ ] Upstream-eligible?: state yes/no and why; link tracking when applicable.
- [ ] Privacy scan clean (§16): include commit identities and shared reports.
- [ ] Use descriptive commit subjects following CONTRIBUTING.md (72 characters maximum; Card: trailer).

If requesting the `no-doc-change` label, the reviewer must agree with the reason.
Justification: <!-- Explain why documentation does not need to change. -->
